title: DNA evaluation run v1
description: The output directory of `dna-eval run` (`dna.eval_run/v1`, PROP-0011): validation evidence about a DNA revision, not a DNA result contract. No file carries the identifier: `run.json` records the harness revision (`source.revision`), and the schema at that revision describes the run. An instance is the directory read as one object keyed by file name. A `.json` file is its JSON value and a `.md` file its text. A `.tsv` file is UTF-8 text of lines ending in a newline, without carriage returns: optional comment lines starting `# `, one header line, then one line per row, every line split on tabs into as many cells as the header has columns; it reads as `comments` (each comment line without `# `, split on tabs), `columns` (the header cells), and `rows` (one object per line, keyed by column).

run.description: The run header: what was run, on what, and how long it took. The only file that records paths, timings, and the database file; every other file depends only on the panel, the truth, DNA's calls, and the identities it names.

source.description: The checkout the harness was built from, recorded by its build script.

revision.description: The git revision; null when unavailable.

dirty.description: Whether tracked files differed from the revision; null when unknown.

sha256.description: The database file's SHA-256, for provenance only.

info.description: The database's `info` table, for provenance only.

digest.description: The panel truth digest of the current database.

recorded_digest.description: The panel truth digest the manifest header records; null when none.

panel_samples_found.description: Panel samples the database has a record of.

identities.description: The distinct identities DNA reported; one unless the inputs changed during the run, none when every sample failed.

baseline.description: The baseline run directory; null without one.

review_window.description: Window of the review workload, in positions.

current_since.description: First batch month of the current data, when given.

run_signal.description: The run-signal grouping, when the reviews were judged against one.

recheck.description: With `--recheck`: the re-check list the pass measures read (difference blocks whose truth is under re-check), its file's SHA-256, and its rows.

evidence_cache.description: With `--evidence-cache`: the read evidence cache the run read and filled. Every read was analysed from its `dna.read_evidence/v1` document; the key names the generation, which holds documents made under this configuration by this `sanger` version and read-stage code.

code_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the read stage's code identity: the git object ids of every source on the path from a trace to its document, at the harness's commit.

misses.description: Traces processed and stored: absent or unreadable entries.

replaced.description: Of the misses, entries present but unreadable, replaced.

bytes.description: Bytes of the generation's entries after the run.

zones.description: The widths that place the review zones, in positions.

constants.description: The harness's measurement constants, so that a run's measures can be reproduced from its outputs; shares in thousandths.

lod_share.description: Limit of detection of a second base (`haplotype_lod`).

faint_share.description: Smallest share of a faint second base, for discrepancy causes.

minor_floor_share.description: Smallest second-channel weight the triage evidence keeps.

minor_noise_calls.description: Calls on each side of a call whose second channels give its local noise.

local_shadow_share.description: Share of a read's nearby calls showing the same shadow that marks it local.

noise_ratio.description: Multiple of its local noise a second channel needs to count.

upper_bound_alpha.description: One-sided level of the Clopper–Pearson upper bounds.

interval_z.description: Normal quantile of the two-sided 95 % intervals and Wilson bounds.

triage_window_margin.description: Positions around a repeat window that count as inside it, for triage.

triage_footprint_positions.description: Clean positions a read observes in a region for its primer to count.

workload.description: What passes without review (a sample, a region, or a zone that no check item touches), over the samples the review workload counts (compared under `haplotype_lod` with a concordant or discordant status): `all` over every one, `current` over those of the current data, with `current_since`. Shares are each count over its total.

triage.description: With `--triage`: the reported policy (`<name>: <parameters>`), the number of policies swept, and the time to decide and score them.

passes.description: What passes without review over one set of samples.

auto_pass.description: Samples without a check item (`review_clear` `Y`), and those of them with an unreviewed block.

regions.description: One region per sample and region of the target profile's zones: `total`, those needing a check (a check item touches one of its zones, `<kind>@<region>`), and the passed ones holding an unreviewed block's first position; overall and per region, in profile order.

zones.description: One zone per sample and zone instance of the target profile (a kind in a region): `total`, those a check item touches (the sum of `review_zone_count`), and the passed ones holding an unreviewed block's first position; overall and per zone, in the order of the summary's zone table.

unit.description: One region (`HV1`) or zone (`after@HV2`) of the target profile over the samples counted.

name.description: A region's name (the HV region that holds its first position, else its bounds), or a zone's `<kind>@<region>`.

checked.description: Samples with a check item in the region's zones, or touching the zone.

unreviewed.description: The other samples whose unreviewed blocks start in the region or zone (by first position).

escaped.description: The passed samples, regions, or zones that hold an unreviewed difference block (one no check item overlaps): in all, and split by the most severe class of their blocks. A block is re-check when the run's `recheck` list names a span it overlaps for its sample, else truth N when the truth writes `N` in it, else het when the truth writes an IUPAC code of two or three bases in it, else non-het: a DNA error that neither a heteroplasmy, a truth `N`, nor the re-check list explains. A unit is `non_het` with a non-het block, else `truth_n_only` with a truth N block, else `het_only` with a het block, else `recheck_only`; the four sum to `total`, and `recheck_only` is 0 without a `recheck` list.

scores.description: One row per panel sample, sorted by `sample_id`. The comparison columns are empty when the sample failed (`status` `failed`).

truth_batch.description: The truth database's batch of the sample; empty without a truth record.

retired.description: Whether the panel retired the sample; a retired sample is left out of the estimates.

concordant.description: The primary concordance code of the lab's comparison; empty when failed.

dna_alleles.description: Distinct DNA alleles, special positions included.

truth_alleles.description: Distinct truth alleles, special positions included.

dna_unique.description: DNA alleles absent from the truth (`263G`, `249DEL`, `309.1C`), special positions left out, in position order.

truth_unique.description: Truth alleles absent from DNA, written as `dna_unique`.

reasons.description: Why the primary measure differs, comma-separated.

positions.description: The primary discordant positions, in position order.

iupac_only.description: Whether every primary difference is a truth IUPAC allele.

regions.description: The windows of the primary discordant positions, comma-separated.

uncovered.description: Truth alleles outside DNA's callable intervals, written as `dna_unique`.

haplotype_blocks.description: The haplotype differing blocks, of the way that decides each interval, that hold a discordant position.

below_lod.description: The truth IUPAC positions below the limit of detection, which `haplotype_lod` compares compatibly; empty when failed.

class_regions.description: The windows of the class's discordant positions, comma-separated.

cause.description: The cause of the discrepancy; empty for a sample without one.

cause_scope.description: Whether the cause is a defect or deferred by design; empty with `cause`.

empop_ranges.description: The EMPOP query ranges (`16024-16365 73-340`); empty when the profile declares no `[empop]`.

empop_undecided.description: Positions inside the EMPOP ranges that the consensus left undecided.

empop_ties.description: Positions inside the EMPOP ranges that the consensus decided by a tie.

callable_yield.description: DNA's callable yield per HV region: the truth's analysed positions there that DNA's callable intervals cover; empty when failed.

traces.description: Distinct traces given to DNA once repeated content is removed; empty when a trace could not be read.

rejected_traces.description: Traces DNA set aside before the consensus; empty when DNA failed.

failure.description: The failure, `<kind>: <message>`, with control characters as spaces; empty unless `status` is `failed`.

review_checks.description: The review list's check items; the review columns are empty unless the sample is compared under `haplotype_lod`.

review_positions.description: Positions of the review windows a check item touches.

review_clear.description: `Y` when the sample has no check item.

unreviewed.description: The `haplotype_lod` difference blocks no check item overlaps.

unreviewed_forced.description: The same, also leaving out blocks a forced window overlaps; empty without `--forced-windows`.

review_zones.description: The review zones a check item touches, space-separated.

estimates.description: Per weighting, measure, and metric: one row per stratum, then the `all` row with the interval.

weighting.description: `corpus` weighs by `weight_corpus`, `pool` by `weight`; retired samples weigh nothing.

metric.description: `not_concordant`: anything but `Y` under the measure; `discordant`: `N`; `failed`: the sample failed.

ci95.description: The half-width of the 95 % interval; `all` rows only.

anchors.description: One row per anchor candidate, by `sample_id`.

baseline_status.description: The primary status the baseline's `scores.tsv` records, as written there (earlier runs may write `exact` or `error`); empty without one.

change.description: The primary change against the baseline; empty without a baseline.

windows.description: One row per review window of `review_window` positions, by region and start. Counted samples are those compared under `haplotype_lod` with a concordant or discordant status.

end.description: Last position, inclusive; a region's last window may be shorter.

samples.description: Counted samples whose analysed intervals reach the window.

checked.description: Those with a check item in the window.

unreviewed.description: Those without one that have an unreviewed difference in it.

unreviewed_share.description: `unreviewed` over the samples without a check item there; empty when there is none.

unreviewed_upper95.description: The Wilson 95 % upper bound of that share.

diff.description: With a baseline: per measure the baseline reports, each sample whose status class changed, including added and removed samples, by sample and measure.

stratum.description: The stratum; empty for a removed sample.

baseline_status.description: The baseline's status, as written there; empty for an added sample.

status.description: The status now; empty for a removed sample.

truth_changes.description: Whenever the panel's truth changed (`run.json` `truth.state` `changed`): each sample whose truth digest differs from the manifest's record, or that records none under a header that does, in panel order. Only the header when no row differs.

recorded_digest.description: The manifest's truth digest of the sample; `-` when the row records none.

current_digest.description: The sample's truth digest in the current database.

checks.description: One row per sample and `dna review` check item, in panel then item order; failed samples have none.

unreviewed.description: One row per sample and `haplotype_lod` difference block that no check item overlaps, in panel then block order: its first and last anchors (1-based), its text as in `scores.tsv` `unreviewed`, its class as the pass measures split it (re-check list, then truth `N`, then a truth heteroplasmy, else a non-het DNA error), the review zone that holds its first anchor, and whether a check item touches that zone. `dna-eval diff` counts the passes of two runs from it.

zone.description: The review zone (`kind@region`) holding the block's first anchor; `.` outside every zone.

zone_checked.description: Whether a check item of the sample touches that zone; `.` without one.

signals.description: With `--run-signal`: one row per run-signal group, by group.

group.description: `batch:<manifest batch>` or `month:<first seven characters of batch_date>` (`month:unknown` without one).

components.description: One row per sample, read, phase mixture, and component (ADR-0082), in panel order; then once per reference run cluster in the component's span: runs of at least 4 identical bases one base apart, measured over a window one base wider on each side. A component whose span covers no cluster, or a mixture that was not decomposed, has one row with the cluster columns `.`.

batch_date.description: The manifest `batch_date`; empty without the column.

offset.description: The component's phase offset, in calls.

span.description: The component's reference span, `<first>-<last>`, 1-based, the first exceeding the last across the origin; `.` for a mixture whose components were not placed, which lists offsets and fractions only.

run.description: The cluster, `<first>-<last>` of its runs, 1-based; `.` without one.

entered.description: The run the read enters in phase (the first after the cluster's left flank for a forward read, the last before its right flank for a reverse one) in the component's haplotype, as base and length (`C9`); from haplotypes, so independent of how the aligner splits an edit; `.` where an edit crosses the window's edge.

truth_entered.description: The same run in the truth's haplotype; `.` where the truth has an IUPAC symbol in the window or no record.

agrees.description: Whether the component's haplotype over the window is the truth's; `.` when either is unmeasured.

tracts.description: One row per sample, read, and tract decode (PROP-0012 increment 2), in panel order and the read's onset order: the tract located before each call where the read leaves phase, its chosen structure, and its first-run and total length marginals. Evidence only; nothing in it is compared with the truth.

batch_date.description: The manifest `batch_date`; empty without the column.

onset.description: The call where the read leaves phase, after the tract (0-based).

onset_reason.description: The read's reason for masking the onset call, why it left phase there (`post_homopolymer`, `dephased_signal`, `mixed_signal`, `weak_signal`, `irregular_spacing`); `.` when the call is not masked.

to_end.description: Whether the read stays out of phase from the onset to its end: no later call is scored.

reference.description: The reference position (1-based) the tract's first call is aligned to; `.` when it is not aligned to a reference base.

run.description: The run base on the read strand.

mark.description: The chosen structure's mark on the read strand; `.` for a single run.

extent.description: Calls from the tract's first one that read the run or the mark.

first_share.description: Its share of the fitted signal.

first_next.description: The first run's next length with a positive share; `.` when a single length shows.

first_z.description: The dominant share's margin over the next, in standard errors deflated by the read's residual autocorrelation; `.` when a single length shows.

first_margin.description: How the first run's dominant length stands against the next: `clear`, `near_equal`, or `undefined` (two lengths without a finite margin; never clear).

total.description: The total's dominant length: run, mark, and run.

total_share.description: Its share of the fitted signal.

total_next.description: The total's next length with a positive share; `.` when a single length shows.

total_margin.description: How the total's dominant length stands against the next: `clear`, `near_equal`, or `undefined` (two lengths without a finite margin; never clear).

cleaned_first.description: The first run's dominant length refitted with the read's own signatures and leakage; `.` without a refit.

forms.description: How the reviewers write each sequence over the whole truth database, without sample identifiers. The first line is a comment recording the truth database file's SHA-256; `run --forms` reads the file back only for that database.

kind.description: `window`: a repeat window's written forms; `outside`: a set of calls outside the windows.

form.description: The written calls in the window, or the set of calls outside them, space-separated; `-` for an empty one.

triage.description: With `--triage`, under the draft policy of PROP-0004 phase 0 (the sweep's first policy, `run.json` `triage.policy`); research only. One row per sample, sorted by `sample_id`, retired ones included.

outcome.description: The triage class: the draft's outcome, or `failed` when DNA failed on a sample with an admitted read (a sample without one is decided, `rerun`).

findings.description: Each region detector's positions, `<region>:<detector>=<positions>`, comma-separated, then `minor_unavailable=<reason>` when the minor channels could not be read.

poor_traces.description: Each poor trace with its findings, `<trace>=<finding>+<finding>`, comma-separated.

rerun_traces.description: The traces a rerun asks for, comma-separated.

triage_regions.description: With `--triage`, under the draft policy of PROP-0004 phase 0 (the sweep's first policy, `run.json` `triage.policy`); research only. One row per sample with triage evidence and region, in sample then region order.

rerun_traces.description: The traces the region's rerun asks for, comma-separated.

primary_positions.description: The `primary` discordant positions in the region.

strict_positions.description: The `strict` discordant positions in the region.

iupac_compatible_positions.description: The `iupac_compatible` discordant positions in the region.

haplotype_positions.description: The `haplotype` discordant positions in the region.

haplotype_iupac_compatible_positions.description: The `haplotype_iupac_compatible` discordant positions in the region.

haplotype_lod_positions.description: The `haplotype_lod` discordant positions in the region.

triage_traces.description: With `--triage`, under the draft policy of PROP-0004 phase 0 (the sweep's first policy, `run.json` `triage.policy`); research only. One row per input trace of a sample with triage evidence.

primer.description: The primer its name carries; empty when none is recognised.

callable_span.description: The callable span in calls, from the first to the last unmasked call; empty when the read did not reach callability.

rerun_for.description: The regions whose rerun asks for the trace, comma-separated; `no_admitted_read` for a sample without an admitted read.

triage_leaks.description: With `--triage`, under the draft policy of PROP-0004 phase 0 (the sweep's first policy, `run.json` `triage.policy`); research only. Every discordant position inside a passed region, under each measure, by sample.

window.description: The repeat window of the position, or `other`.

class.description: The difference: `iupac` when a truth allele is IUPAC, else `insertion`, `deletion`, or `substitution`.

marked_by.description: The detectors marking the position, comma-separated.

triage_detectors.description: With `--triage`, under the draft policy of PROP-0004 phase 0 (the sweep's first policy, `run.json` `triage.policy`); research only. One row per region detector, over the scored (not retired), compared samples. An applied detector fills `unique_*` and `sole_burden`, one the policy does not apply fills `if_applied_*`; the other set is `-`.

unique_primary.description: Catches under `primary` no other applied detector shares.

unique_strict.description: Catches under `strict` no other applied detector shares.

unique_iupac_compatible.description: Catches under `iupac_compatible` no other applied detector shares.

unique_haplotype.description: Catches under `haplotype` no other applied detector shares.

unique_haplotype_iupac_compatible.description: Catches under `haplotype_iupac_compatible` no other applied detector shares.

unique_haplotype_lod.description: Catches under `haplotype_lod` no other applied detector shares.

sole_burden.description: Burden no other applied detector shares.

if_applied_catches_primary.description: Catches under `primary` applying it would add.

if_applied_catches_strict.description: Catches under `strict` applying it would add.

if_applied_catches_iupac_compatible.description: Catches under `iupac_compatible` applying it would add.

if_applied_catches_haplotype.description: Catches under `haplotype` applying it would add.

if_applied_catches_haplotype_iupac_compa.description: Catches under `haplotype_iupac_compatible` applying it would add.

if_applied_catches_haplotype_lod.description: Catches under `haplotype_lod` applying it would add.

triage_positions.description: With `--triage`, under the draft policy of PROP-0004 phase 0 (the sweep's first policy, `run.json` `triage.policy`); research only. One row per region position, in region then position order.

samples.description: Scored samples with region evidence there.

triage_sweep.description: With `--triage`, under the draft policy of PROP-0004 phase 0 (the sweep's first policy, `run.json` `triage.policy`); research only. One row per policy of the sweep, the draft first.

parameters.description: Its parameters, `key=value` pairs separated by spaces.

review_corpus.description: The corpus-weighted share sent to review.

rerun_corpus.description: The corpus-weighted share sent to rerun.

triage_policies.description: With `--triage`, under the draft policy of PROP-0004 phase 0 (the sweep's first policy, `run.json` `triage.policy`); research only. One row per sample, sorted by `sample_id`, retired ones included; then one column per policy of the sweep, named as in `triage_sweep.tsv`, the draft first. `dna-eval power` reads it.

additionalProperties.description: The sample's class under the policy.

triage_minor.description: With `--triage`, under the draft policy of PROP-0004 phase 0 (the sweep's first policy, `run.json` `triage.policy`); research only. One row per policy of the minor-signal measurement: the reported policy and each policy with another `region.minor_signal` rule, against the same policy without the rule.

pass_corpus_without.description: The corpus-weighted share passed without the rule.

moved.description: Compared samples the rule alone moves from pass to review.

iupac_sites.description: Truth IUPAC positions inside regions that pass without the rule.

iupac_sites_all.description: Truth IUPAC positions in any region.

passed_without_primary.description: Passed samples compared under `primary` without the rule.

leak_upper95_primary.description: The one-sided 95 % upper bound with the rule.

leak_rate_corpus_primary.description: The corpus-weighted leak rate with the rule.

passed_without_strict.description: Passed samples compared under `strict` without the rule.

leak_upper95_strict.description: The one-sided 95 % upper bound with the rule.

leak_rate_corpus_strict.description: The corpus-weighted leak rate with the rule.

passed_without_iupac_compatible.description: Passed samples compared under `iupac_compatible` without the rule.

leak_upper95_iupac_compatible.description: The one-sided 95 % upper bound with the rule.

leak_rate_corpus_iupac_compatible.description: The corpus-weighted leak rate with the rule.

passed_without_haplotype.description: Passed samples compared under `haplotype` without the rule.

leak_upper95_haplotype.description: The one-sided 95 % upper bound with the rule.

leak_rate_corpus_haplotype.description: The corpus-weighted leak rate with the rule.

passed_without_haplotype_iupac_compatibl.description: Passed samples compared under `haplotype_iupac_compatible` without the rule.

leak_upper95_haplotype_iupac_compatible.description: The one-sided 95 % upper bound with the rule.

leak_rate_corpus_haplotype_iupac_compati.description: The corpus-weighted leak rate with the rule.

passed_without_haplotype_lod.description: Passed samples compared under `haplotype_lod` without the rule.

leak_upper95_haplotype_lod.description: The one-sided 95 % upper bound with the rule.

leak_rate_corpus_haplotype_lod.description: The corpus-weighted leak rate with the rule.

markdown.description: A Markdown report for people, in aggregate; its text is not a contract.

no_comments.description: The table has no comment line.

weight.description: A finite non-negative number as the manifest writes it.

code.description: `Y` concordant, `N` discordant, `N/A` one side has no allele; empty when failed.

class.description: The discrepancy class: the part of DNA that owns the difference.

blocks.description: Differing blocks, space-separated: `<start>-<end>[+]:<DNA>/<truth>`, `+` when open, `-` for an empty sequence, a sequence over 24 symbols as its first and last 10 and its length (`CCCTCCCCCC..TTCTGGCCAC(40)`).

triage_region.description: A region of the target profile, `<first>-<last>`, 1-based.
